FOUND (flag for owner): UTokyo has no undergraduate department named 'Computer Science'. The Faculty of Science's Department of Information Science (情報科学科) is the university's undergraduate computer science programme: its own English site is titled 'Department of Computer Science, The University of Tokyo' (HTML <title> of every /en/ page) and its curriculum 'focuses on basic courses in computer science'. 'Information Science' is not literally in the owner's CS list (Computer Science / Informatics / Informatik / CSE); recorded as the programme because the department names itself Computer Science in English. If the owner rules otherwise, change the role to 'related'. Entry is not direct: students are admitted to the College of Arts and Sciences (Komaba, e.g. Natural Sciences I) and choose the department in the second year (late specialisation); the English-taught PEAK programme has no computer science course. Japanese-taught.
